newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stocks spend week in Ramadan doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stocks spend week in Ramadan doldrums.

text.p: Trade on Qatar's unofficial stock market was subdued for the third week running, in a routine drop in activity during the Islamic month of Ramadan, brokers said.
Four shares rose, two fell and 12 remained unchanged in the week to Thursday.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's (CBQ) 18-share index fell for the first time in months to 126.70 points from 127.07 the previous week.
Gainers included Qatar General Insurance and Qatar Navigation which advanced five riyals each to 610 and 780 respectively.
Doha Bank Ltd gathered two riyals to 292 and Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company added half a riyal to 56.
Losers included Qatar Insurance, which lost 95 riyals to 550 and Qatar Cinema, which fell 10 riyals to 180 after announcing cash dividends equal to 15 percent of its capital.
Qatar Insurance also announced a cash dividend equal to 25 percent of the capital and a one-for-nine bonus share issue.
